question: Should this DSSE format transition be accepted after a maintainer verifies the legacy/standard parser boundary and a real ClawHub signer-to-OpenClaw proof is attached?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes parsing at the signed catalog trust boundary; the protected maintainer label and absent end-to-end producer proof require an explicit owner decision rather than automated handling.

options.title: Review with live interoperability proof
options.body: Require a rebased head plus redacted output showing ClawHub’s standard DSSE envelope is accepted under the configured trust profile and malformed or mixed envelopes are rejected.

options.title: Pause the transition
options.body: Keep the existing beta-format-only consumer until the producer format and cross-repository release sequencing are explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Review with live interoperability proof
recommendation.body: Require a rebased head plus redacted output showing ClawHub’s standard DSSE envelope is accepted under the configured trust profile and malformed or mixed envelopes are rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor across this PR and the directly linked DSSE feed follow-ups; formal current-main area ownership could not be established in the unavailable terminal.
